fields.title: Mode
fields.description: Select if the chunking is based on a fixed number of rows per chunk or a fixed number of chunks.

fields.title: Rows per chunk
fields.description: Set the number of rows per chunk. The number of iterations is the row count of the input table divided by this value. To implement a streaming approach with one row at a time, set this value to 1.

fields.title: Number of chunks
fields.description: Set the number of chunks. The number of rows per chunk is the row count of the input table divided by this value.
